jobs.title: Founding Strategic Partnerships, Cloud & Alliances
jobs.description:
ABOUT RETELL AI

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent recognition:

 - No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026 https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/voice-ai-startup-retell-ai-145200025.html

 - Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025) https://a16z.com/the-ai-application-spending-report-where-startup-dollars-really-go/

 - #3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://company.g2.com/news/g2s-2026-best-software-awards

 - Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026 https://www.retellai.com/blog/retell-ai-recognized-as-the-best-agentic-ai-software-by-g2

 - #4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025 https://www.brex.com/journal/brex-benchmark-december-2025

 - Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC https://www.nasdaq.com/videos/retell-ai

 - Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard https://leanaileaderboard.com/

 - Backed by Y Combinator https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/retell-ai

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, American Airlines, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

We’re looking for a Founding Strategic Partnerships, Cloud & Alliances to help build and scale Retell AI’s ecosystem partnerships and go-to-market alliances.

In this role, you’ll identify, negotiate, and manage strategic relationships across cloud providers, AI platforms, systems integrators, channel partners, and enterprise technology ecosystems. You’ll work directly with founders and GTM leadership to expand Retell AI’s market reach, drive partner-sourced pipeline, and develop long-term strategic relationships that accelerate company growth.

This is a highly cross-functional role that combines business development, partnerships, strategic relationship management, and ecosystem growth. We’re looking for someone who is commercially minded, highly relationship-oriented, and excited to operate in a fast-moving startup environment with significant ownership.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own a portfolio spanning cloud hyperscalers, CCaaS and CRM platforms, and consultancies, SIs, and BPOs.

 - Own the outcomes for your portfolio: activated partnerships, partner-sourced SQLs, co-sold pipeline, and closed-won repeatable revenue against quarterly targets.

 - Run the cloud hyperscaler motion: launch and grow marketplace and co-sell programs (listings, private offers, and co-sell programs that comp partner AEs to sell Retell), manage relationships with PDMs, drive joint outbound with their AEs, deliver field presentations, and show up at partner conferences and kickoffs.

 - Run the CCaaS and strategic partner motion: build joint offerings with CCaaS and CRM platforms, SIs, consultancies, and BPOs. Establish co-sell, resale, referral, and implementation models; enable partner teams; map shared accounts; and support joint pursuits through deployment.

 - Vet, sign, and activate strategic partners, consultancies, SIs, and BPOs: develop and launch enablement initiatives (training paths, certification, GTM plays, shared marketing assets) so their consultants can position and deploy Retell in client work, plus joint pursuit support on live deals.

 - Drive co-marketing across the portfolio and represent Retell in the ecosystem: joint launches, blog posts, demos, industry conferences, joint partner events, and roundtables.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Sales, FDEs, Product, Engineering, and Marketing to ensure partner performance and alignment with Retell's revenue strategy.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years of experience in strategic or channel partnerships at a high-growth SaaS company.

 - Deep experience working with cloud hyperscalers, CCaaS or CRM platforms, consultancies, SIs, or BPOs.

 - Proven ability to build partner programs from zero and launch successful marketplace, co-sell, resale, or implementation motions.

 - Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

 - Excellent organizational, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to represent Retell across the ecosystem.
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You’re highly relationship-oriented and naturally enjoy building trust with customers, partners, and executives

 - You’re commercially minded and excited by pipeline generation, partnerships, and business growth

 - You enjoy operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments with high ownership

 - You’re comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution

 - You communicate clearly and can influence both internal stakeholders and external executives

 - You enjoy networking, attending industry events, and representing the company externally

 - You learn quickly and enjoy understanding technical products and AI infrastructure ecosystems




JOB DETAILS

 - Cash: 170k - 230k + Meaningful Equity

 - Travel: Frequent travel required for conferences, partner meetings, customer engagements, and ecosystem events

 - Reporting Structure: Directly reports to company leadership and works closely with GTM, Product, and Engineering teams

 - Location: Redwood City, CA, US

 - US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H1B/H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, F-1 (OPT/CPT), and O-1 visas.
   
   


OTHER BENEFITS

 - 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - $70/day DoorDash credit for unlimited breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

 - $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - High Ownership: Small teams, rapid execution, and meaningful business impact

 - Performance-Oriented: Success is measured through relationship quality, pipeline generation, and ecosystem growth

 - Top Talent Density: Work alongside ambitious operators and builders at one of the fastest-growing AI startups

 - Career Growth: Strong performers will have opportunities to expand into broader strategic partnerships and GTM leadership roles




INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Recruiter Screen (15 min): Background, motivations, compensation, and partnership experience.

 2. GTM team member interview (30 min): Overview, sales process and methodology.

 3. CEO Interview (30 min): This call will focus on your experience selling technical products. 

 4. Final Onsite (2.5 hrs): Deep dive into past partnerships, strategic thinking, and cross-functional execution.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Compliance Engineer (Contract) to help build and own the systems, processes, and technical controls that keep Retell secure, compliant, and enterprise-ready. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Security, Legal, and customer-facing teams to ensure our infrastructure and products meet the security and compliance requirements of the world’s largest companies.

This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll translate compliance requirements into technical controls, automate evidence collection, identify gaps, and help build the systems that allow Retell to move quickly without compromising security or compliance.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Compliance Engineering: Build and maintain technical controls across security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, and other enterprise requirements.

 - Automation: Automate compliance workflows, evidence collection, access reviews, security checks, and other repetitive processes.

 - Security Controls: Partner with Engineering and Security to implement and monitor controls around access management, infrastructure, data protection, logging, and vulnerability management.

 - Audit Readiness: Support audits by owning technical evidence collection and working with auditors to address compliance requirements.

 - Enterprise Security: Work with customers and internal teams to respond to security questionnaires, compliance requirements, and technical due diligence.

 - Continuous Improvement: Identify gaps in our compliance and security programs and build scalable systems to address them.
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF

 - You have a strong technical background in software engineering, security, infrastructure, IT, or a related field.

 - You’re interested in compliance, security, and how technology can be used to build scalable compliance programs.

 - You’re comfortable learning new security and compliance frameworks and turning requirements into practical technical solutions.

 - You have strong scripting or programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Bash, or a similar language.

 - You understand security fundamentals such as IAM, encryption, networking, logging, vulnerability management, and cloud security.

 - You’re highly analytical and enjoy solving ambiguous problems.

 - You’re comfortable working across Engineering, Security, Legal, and customer-facing teams.

 - You communicate clearly and can explain technical and compliance concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 - Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, or other compliance frameworks is a plus.

 - Experience with AWS, GCP, Vanta, Drata, Wiz, Okta, or similar tools is a plus.
   
   


JOB DETAILS

 - Employment Type: Full-Time or Part-Time 1099 Contractor

 - Location: Remote

 - Compensation: $6000–$7500 USD/Month, based on experience

 - Hours: Must be open to working some overlapping hours with our Pacific Time team and customers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Procurement Manager to build and own procurement at Retell as we scale.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is commercially sharp, analytical, and comfortable building things from scratch. You’ll own vendor selection, sourcing, negotiation, contracting, and ongoing vendor management across the company.

You’ll work closely with Finance, Legal, Engineering, IT, HR, and leadership to make sure we’re getting the best value from every major vendor and building a procurement function that can scale with the company.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own procurement across the company, from sourcing through contracting and renewals

 - Lead vendor selection, evaluation, and negotiation

 - Manage strategic software, infrastructure, and other company spend

 - Identify opportunities for cost savings and vendor consolidation

 - Build procurement processes, policies, and approval workflows from scratch

 - Partner with Finance and Legal on contracts, budgets, and vendor risk

 - Track company spend and improve visibility into vendor costs

 - Build strong relationships with key vendors and negotiate favorable terms

 - Use automation and AI to make procurement faster and more efficient

 - Help build the procurement function as Retell continues to scale.
   
   


YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF YOU

 - Have 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or purchasing

 - Have strong vendor negotiation and contract negotiation experience

 - Have owned meaningful company spend of over $25M.

 - Have experience at a fast-growing technology company or startup

 - Have experience with SaaS, software, or technical procurement

 - Are highly analytical and comfortable working with spend data

 - Can operate independently without much existing structure

 - Have built procurement processes or functions from scratch

 - Move quickly and avoid unnecessary bureaucracy

 - Are a strong communicator and can work across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Engineering, IT, and HR

 


JOB DETAILS

Cash: $165,000 - $205,000

Equity: 4-year vest / 1-year cliff

Location: Redwood City, California (Relocation support provided)

US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, and F-1 (OPT/CPT).

 


OTHER BENEFITS

 - 100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - $70/day DoorDash credit for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks

 - $200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)

 - $300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)

 - $75/month phone bill reimbursement

 - $50/month internet reimbursement

 


COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

 - Best offer upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed

 - Top 1% talent: Above-market pay (top 5th percentile) to attract exceptional builders

 - High ownership: small teams, >$1M revenue per employee, and significant equity

 - Performance-based: Offers tied to interview performance, not tenure or past salary
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Talent Screen — 15 min

 2. Functional Interview — 45 min

 3. Hiring Manager — 30 min

 4. Final Interviews — 3 hrs
